pages: The front door. Email-only in the training build; a real deployment puts SSO here.
The desk view: what is breached, what is aging, what needs a decision today.
The work queue, ordered by Reg E deadline. Red BREACHED badges are the problem the whole engagement exists to fix.
One case, whole: the transaction, evidence gathered across source systems, the Reg E clock, the actions an analyst may take — and Linked tickets, where the agent's recommendations land.
The core-banking view — 100k seeded transactions. This is the 'disparate system' an analyst would otherwise open in another tab.
Customer records: segment, tenure, and the disputes they have filed.
The policy library the agent cites from. Chunk ids here are what appear as [chunk NN] in every recommendation — and one chunk is deliberately poisoned.
Where every agent write lands — the newest ticket is the last run. The subject line names which door wrote it.
